contract.atomicFactSet: complete `CandidateDeliverySnapshot@1` + Libra-owned `SubjectContinuityResolutionDecision@1` + `LibraBindingDraft@1` + `AcceptedIntakePayload@1` + Subject Continuity head CAS + unique extension target Intake head CAS（带Continuity/Episode Claim的Decision必须精确匹配冻结head；无Claim的新Movie Subject可在同一原子事务验证当前head完整性后从current head推进，不因无关Subject提交而全局串行）+ immutable Intake Decision/match witness/overlap Evidence + Subject create/extension + accepted continuity/Episode scope + Primary `primary_control` Binding、exclusive Related `related_derived` Binding及N:M Episode relation + precise Primary Control transfer + `SubjectAndTransferReceipt@1`/commit marker/accepted Outbox；Related Disposition Scope与两类Binding必须和Primary Control transfer在同一事务全有或全无，但Related不得进入Control revision set；全部Physical Identity/size/endpoint/location逐项复制Snapshot，不能旁读current Field/Provider补值
